name: Confetti burst
description: Animates the subject to explode into slow-motion colorful confetti.

prompt.seedance: Locked camera, one continuous shot. The subject begins still, then proceeds to explode into slow-motion colorful confetti. Paper pieces spin and glitter as they fill the frame. Physically accurate motion.
prompt.veo: The subject begins still, then proceeds to explode into slow-motion colorful confetti. Paper pieces spin and glitter as they fill the frame. Cinematic lighting, realistic physics, locked camera.
